title: Where should a convention live? Ask what it follows
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: A procedure people run on request
rule: Conventions that follow a file pattern across directories belong in .claude/rules/ with paths: globs. Directory CLAUDE.md files only suit conventions confined to one folder.

title: Claude ignores an instruction: diagnose, then place it
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: See the files actually in context
Reduces usage; not a memory check
rule: First run /memory to see which memory files are loaded. Then put the rule where it belongs: personal at user level, team standards in the project.

title: Who gets this configuration?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Everyone on the team, on clone
Unwanted habit traced to one person's file
Unwanted habit from many people, no single source
Not sure which files are loaded
rule: User-level CLAUDE.md does not travel with the repo. Fix a habit at the file it comes from.

title: Where should a standard live? Ask who owns it and who needs it
head: Situation
Right home
Why
rows: Standard owned and edited elsewhere in the repo, applies everywhere
References the live file, no copy
Convention for files in one directory
Loads when working in that directory
rule: If someone else owns and updates the document, reference it with @import. Don't copy it.

title: Instructions ignored for one person: diagnose before you fix
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Not sure which memory files are active
Confirmed: personal file contradicts the project
Remove or adjust the personal instruction
Conventions span many folders by file type
CLAUDE.md is huge and hard to maintain
Personal preference leaks into the team's files
rule: When instructions misbehave for one person, check what's loaded with /memory before changing any files.

title: Instructions missing for some people? Ask where they live
head: Finding
Cause
Fix
rows: Conventions apply to only some files
rule: Home-folder CLAUDE.md is personal. Team conventions go in the committed project CLAUDE.md.

title: Who needs this guidance, and for which files?
head: Situation
Right home
Why
rows: Standard for every file, shared with team and CI
Convention for one file type spread across directories
Loads only when matching files are touched
A multi-step procedure run on demand
rule: Personal file → only you. Team-wide, every-file standards → committed project CLAUDE.md. Rules with paths are for conventions tied to certain files.

title: Rules ignored? Find out which of the two causes it is
head: What you observe
Likely cause
Next step
rows: Rules ignored, nobody knows if they load
Fix the path or move the file
File loaded, output follows rules loosely
Rules apply only to test files across many dirs
Rules work locally but not for teammates
rule: Before you tune a prompt, confirm the guidance is in the context. /memory shows what loaded.
